title: Mario Woods becomes obsessed with pyramids after Ellsworth abduction
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Mario Woods, uh, from the Ellsworth Air Force Base, uh, abduction experience, South Dakota, 1977.

guys made fun of me in the missile field cuz I'd sit at the dining room tables in the day room and I'd draw a pyramid. I'd put a weird top on it and little sparks coming out of it. Now, I call that an Atlantean pyramid.
tellings.difference: Told firsthand: he drew pyramids with odd tops and sparks, he calls them 'Atlantean', and other airmen mocked him for it.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Mario Woods becoming fixated on pyramids after the 1977 Ellsworth abduction; here Mario himself describes drawing them in the missile field day room.

as_told.title: Mario draws 'Atlantean' pyramids in the missile field after the abduction
as_told.place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota, USA

plain: After an alien abduction he says he lived through at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in 1977, a young airman named Mario Woods became obsessed with drawing pyramids. Woods tells it himself: other airmen at the missile field laughed at him because he would sit in the day room drawing pyramids with "a weird top on it and little sparks coming out of it," which he now calls "an Atlantean pyramid," after the legendary lost city of Atlantis. Michels also mentions Woods and the Ellsworth abduction of 1977 in another episode, repeating what Woods told him. The drawings are told as a lasting mark the experience left on him.
